headline: Recommended National Register listing for the Harvey Gammage schooner at 100 West Commercial Street
summary: A National Register nomination for the Harvey Gammage, a two-masted wooden schooner, was reviewed and recommended for listing. A workshop on new construction at 101 and 105 Winter Street was also held, with no vote.
decisions: Recommended that the Harvey Gammage at 100 West Commercial Street be listed on the National Register, 5-0.
discussion: Harvey Gammage nomination: Members said the report supported listing based on the vessel's 1973 construction and its place in sailing and maritime history.
Winter Street new construction: Members discussed the long second-floor brick wall, the size of the windows, and how visible the rear building is from the street.
Facade rhythm: Public comment supported keeping the unit-by-unit pattern rather than grouping the last two units, and members suggested breaking up the long brick wall with shadow lines.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll move to recommend the Maine Historic Preservation Commission support the nomination for the Harvey gomage docked at 100 West Commercial Street ... Motion carries. All present in favor.
